faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Cupertino?
faq.answer: Cupertino homeowners typically invest $7,000 to $17,000 for a full window replacement project. This premium Silicon Valley city features a mix of 1960s–1980s ranches and newer luxury homes. Projects frequently include premium glass packages for energy efficiency and UV protection of high-value interiors. Single window installation starts at approximately $600.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Cupertino?
faq.answer: Yes. Cupertino requires a building permit for window replacements, including like-for-like replacements. Our team manages all Cupertino permit applications and coordinates with the Community Development Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Cupertino?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Cupertino commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Cupertino?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Cupertino replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Cupertino?
faq.answer: Most Cupertino projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
